Holy_Judge.description: Male human Order vocation: the Maker's arbiter. Reads sin, hears confessions, carries out verdicts. Breath answers him only passively.
Holy_Judge.lore: Holy Judges stand as the Maker's voice, purging corruption with radiant authority, feared even by the Church.

Discern_Sin.name: Interrogate
Discern_Sin.roll: Perception + Willpower + d100 vs the higher of Willpower or Deceive + d100 (tie to the defender)
Discern_Sin.effect: Mundane interrogation. Reads guilt, not magic, and cannot by itself prove a woman is a sorceress. Divine Clarity still gives +10 against lies. No stamina or piety cost. Replaces the old activated Discern Sin.

breath_trigger.target: corrupted beast, demon, ghost, spirit, Veilspawn, abomination or possessed human; never an ordinary sinner or an un-possessed sorceress

Judgment.effect: Attacks against the target deal +4 damage and its Fear tests against you are at -10.
Judgment.replaces: Judgment Call (old active: 12 holy damage, +15 vs corrupted)

Final_Verdict.requires: a legal finding (evidence, confession or a completed exam), not a magical reading of sin
Final_Verdict.effect: Legal authority to pass a sentence from the Mercy of Ash / tribunal menu and have it carried out by ordinary means. Not an instant-kill power and not a Breath miracle.
Final_Verdict.risk: Wrongful sentence on an innocent, or a killing with the unbonded blade, is a heavy piety/Virtue loss and Order punishment

breath_trigger.after: just Final_Verdict against a valid Breath target (possessed human, demon, ghost, spirit, corrupted beast, Veilspawn or abomination)

Purge_Verdict.effect: Allies within 6 m lose Fear and Veil status effects (salt_kiss, taint_mark, brine_marks). Fires only after a just Final Verdict on a valid Breath target, never after sentencing an ordinary sinner.
Purge_Verdict.replaces: Purge Verdict (old active: remove status effects, 12 stamina)

Feared_By_The_Flock.effect: -10 Charisma with common folk who know what you are.
